REVIEW_STATE: Review: %1$s not reviewed, %2$s verified by you, %3$s marked conflicting.
NEW_DOMAIN: Registered only %1$s days ago. New domains are often used for phishing; this alone proves nothing.
EXPIRED: The registration end date has passed (%1$s).
STATUS_HOLD: The domain is on hold (%1$s): it does not resolve on the internet.
STATUS_DELETE: The domain is in a deletion phase (%1$s).
DOMAIN_LOCKED: Transfer lock is on; a change of ownership needs extra steps.
NO_ADDRESS: No A or AAAA record: the name does not point to a server.
NO_MX: No MX record: the domain does not receive e-mail.
NO_SPF: No SPF record: anyone can send e-mail claiming to come from this domain.
SPF_STRICT: SPF is strict (-all): mail from unlisted servers should be rejected.
SPF_SOFT: SPF is soft (~all): mail from unlisted servers is only marked as suspicious.
SPF_WEAK: SPF does not restrict senders (?all, +all or no all rule).
NO_DMARC: No DMARC policy: receiving servers get no instruction for spoofed mail.
DMARC_NONE: DMARC policy is p=none: spoofed mail is only reported, not blocked.
NO_CAA: No CAA record: any certificate authority may issue certificates for it.
DNSSEC_ON: DNS answers are validated with DNSSEC.
DNSSEC_OFF: DNSSEC is not in use (answers are not signed).
CDN: Signs of a CDN or cloud provider: %1$s. The real server address may be hidden behind it.
GEO_SPREAD: Location sources agree within %1$s km (largest gap: %2$s vs %3$s).
GEO_FAR: Location sources differ by up to %1$s km (%2$s vs %3$s); treat the position as rough.
COARSE_LOCATION: %1$s reports an accuracy of only ± %2$s km (country level).
VT_FLAGGED: VirusTotal: %1$s engines report malicious, %2$s suspicious (the provider's view).
VT_CLEAN: VirusTotal: no engine reports it as malicious or suspicious.
ABUSE_HIGH: AbuseIPDB abuse confidence %1$s/100: frequently reported (the provider's view).
URLHAUS_LISTED: URLhaus lists %1$s malware URL(s) for this target.
SB_CLEAN: Not on the Google Safe Browsing lists at query time.
OTX_PULSES: Mentioned in %1$s AlienVault OTX threat report(s).
OTX_NONE: No AlienVault OTX threat report mentions it.
MB_UNKNOWN: MalwareBazaar does not know this hash.
SUGGEST_ADD_IP: The domain points to %1$s, which is not a target yet.
ARCHIVE_BEFORE_REGISTRATION: The archive has a copy from %1$s, before the current registration (%2$s): the domain may have changed hands.
VULN_NO_VERSION: No version given: the list covers all versions, not necessarily yours.
PROVIDERS_FAILED: No answer from: %1$s. Run them again later.
KEYS_MISSING: These sources could add more if you enter their free key: %1$s.
